description: Run a full system firmware flash (SYSTEM_UPGRADE) via the app's updateLoaderFirmwareMpy with shouldUpgradeFirmware=true. Executes immediately — multiple reboots, CAN BRICK the device if interrupted. Requires firmwareBinaryB64: the MCP does not replicate the app's cloud package fetch (auth headers + certificate decryption are out of scope), so you must supply the .bin yourself (base64). Requires confirm=true after explicit user approval. DESTRUCTIVE.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user has explicitly approved this specific upgrade on this specific device.

firmwareBinaryB64.description: Base64 of the firmware .bin image. Required — the app fetches its own copies only via its cloud check, which this tool does not replicate.

target.description: Which device to target — pass exactly one field. If omitted, the app must know exactly one device; ambiguous or unmatched targets are refused.

targetVersion.description: Target firmware version string (recorded in checkResult.upgradeFirmwareTo).

name: flash_firmware
title: Full system firmware upgrade
